reading: James Bourne plays guitar in the band Busted.
In September 2025, he left a tour just before it began.
He said he left because he had health problems.
His younger brother Chris played in his place.
Doctors told James that he had only a few years left to live.
Chris later gave James one of his kidneys to save his life.
James says he and Chris are both getting better.
James still needs more time to get well.
He calls his brother a hero.
